Job description:
Firatosoeh Khatib (Khatib Group), with over a decade of experience in selling cash and installment cars, is one of the reputable and leading groups in the country's automotive industry. The media unit of this group, named "Khatib Media," operates in four specialized areas: photography, videography, editing, graphic design, and social media management. Khatib Group has a safe and calm environment that provides opportunities for career advancement and professional progress for all colleagues. Responsibilities include the production and editing of professional images and videos using Artificial Intelligence tools (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Pika, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E, and similar) to design and execute creative visual ideas based on AI for advertising campaigns and social media. This involves optimizing and enhancing the quality of advertising visual and video content using AI technologies. Writing specialized prompts (Prompt Engineering) to generate targeted and high-quality content. Close collaboration with editing, graphic, and social media teams. Research and continuous updating about the latest AI tools and trends in the media industry to participate in developing visual content strategies for the sub-groups of Khatib Group brands, and knowledge transfer to other members of the media team. Requirements include mastery of AI image and video generation tools (submission of samples is mandatory), proficiency in Prompt Engineering, familiarity with the fundamentals of photography, videography, and editing, familiarity with Adobe software (Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects) as complements to AI tools, high creativity, and a strong sense of aesthetics. Continuous follow-up on the latest developments in the field of Artificial Intelligence, familiarity with content production trends on Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, teamwork ability, and appropriate communication skills. Benefits and opportunities include a salary of 35 million Tomans, social insurance, a professional, safe, and calm work environment, the opportunity to work with the latest AI technologies, and the possibility for career growth in a developing group.
